scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.lint: turbo run lint:oxlint --filter=!beluga && pnpm lint:eslint && turbo run lint:eslint --filter=!beluga
scripts.lint:fix: turbo run lint:oxlint:fix --filter=!beluga && pnpm lint:eslint:fix && turbo run lint:eslint:fix --filter=!beluga
scripts.test: turbo run test --filter=!beluga && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts
scripts.release:version: changeset version && node scripts/version-release.mjs && pnpm release:check
